rule: Each value function needs claim, equation, code, test, artifact, CI record, and verdict linkage before score credit.

value_functions.name: canonical_equation_closure
value_functions.gap: GeoSync core exists; experimental bridge remains outside core score until provenance is complete.
value_functions.target: One canonical object per scored subsystem with equation, variables, parameters, units, code path, and test path.
value_functions.next_gate: link every scored claim to code and test

value_functions.name: typed_dimensional_consistency
value_functions.gap: Units are documented but not yet enforced as typed contracts.
value_functions.target: Executable unit contract for theta, omega, K, A, R, Phi, dt, and sampling interval.

value_functions.name: solver_convergence_and_replication
value_functions.gap: dt refinement and NumPy reference exist; replay evidence must bind to current commit.
value_functions.target: Convergence, tolerance, reference solver, and replay artifact pass on the scored commit.

value_functions.name: null_model_and_invariant_matrix
value_functions.gap: Null tests and invariants exist but are not measured as a claim matrix.
value_functions.target: Each positive claim has null, invariant, observable, threshold, and expected behavior record.
value_functions.next_gate: create null/invariant matrix artifact keyed by claim_id

value_functions.name: uncertainty_and_reproducibility_binding
value_functions.gap: UQ smoke exists; sensitivity-ranked parameters are not yet summarized.
value_functions.target: Declared source, sample budget, sensitivity summary, seed, replay command, and CI-bound artifact.
value_functions.next_gate: add small sensitivity summary for IC, omega, K, and dt

value_functions.name: experimental_bridge_provenance
value_functions.gap: Ricci bridge has smoke tests but lacks full graph construction provenance.
value_functions.target: Source definition, graph rule, curvature estimator, bounded transform, comparison records, and artifact summary.

value_functions.name: release_truth_and_readiness
value_functions.gap: Score and verdict exist; target rank remains blocked by PR Gate and source-scope blockers.
value_functions.target: Score, blockers, CI evidence, release verdict, and non-claims are consistent on the current commit.
value_functions.next_gate: derive verdict only from computed score and current CI ledger
